scripts.lint:ts: eslint frontend backend shared --format json -o docs/audits/eslint-report.json
scripts.audit:all: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:css
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend -- -c ci
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:android: npm run build --prefix frontend && npx --prefix frontend cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run env:config && npm run build:android && cmd.exe /c "cd frontend\android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease"
scripts.build:apk:local: npm run env:local && npm run build:android && cmd.exe /c "cd frontend\android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease"
scripts.build:apk:render: npm run env:render && npm run build:android && cmd.exe /c "cd frontend\android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease"
scripts.precommit: npm run brain:sync && npm run db:mirror && npm run audit:rules && (npm run audit:all || (npm run audit:split && exit 1))
